title: Kraken’s Dave Ripley: “That Was the Bear Market” and Bitcoin Is “On Our Way Out of It”
summary: ▶ Bitcoin Magazine Kraken’s Dave Ripley: “That Was the Bear Market” and Bitcoin Is “On Our Way Out of It” Kraken’s Dave Ripley explains why Bitcoin’s rebound past $80K hints the bear market is over, marking the softest macro pullback in the asset’s history. This post Kraken’s Dave Ripley: “That Was the Bear Market” and Bitcoin Is “On Our Way Out of It” first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Mark Mason .
